hero.title: Search and analyze enterprise data across existing systems.
hero.description: Search Anywhere Framework helps organizations work with distributed operational, security, and business data without requiring a complete migration into one central storage. Harmony Technology supports SAF's introduction and partner communication in the Japanese market.

why.title: Why teams explore SAF first
why.text: SAF is designed for environments where data is already spread across operational, security, and business systems, but teams still need faster visibility and better investigation workflows.

distributed_data.title: Distributed data by design
distributed_data.text: Search and analyze across existing environments without making full centralization the starting requirement.

faster_investigation.title: Faster investigation
faster_investigation.text: Reduce the delay between identifying an issue and understanding what happened across multiple data sources.

cross_domain_visibility.title: Cross-domain visibility
cross_domain_visibility.text: Work with operational, security, and business context together when the problem spans more than one system boundary.

phased_adoption.title: Phased adoption
phased_adoption.text: Start with practical use cases and expand without forcing an all-at-once data program before value is visible.

problem_solution.title: A practical answer to fragmented enterprise data

problem.title: Problem
problem.text: Many teams operate across log platforms, databases, infrastructure tools, business systems, and security sources that do not naturally work together. Investigation and visibility become slower when every question requires jumping between disconnected systems.

solution.title: Solution
solution.text: SAF provides a way to search, analyze, correlate, and visualize distributed enterprise data without making a full migration, centralization, or constant reindexing project the first step.

use_cases.title: Use cases worth discussing first
use_cases.text: Search Anywhere Framework can support several high-value scenarios where faster investigation, broader visibility, and cross-system analysis matter.

security_operations.title: Security operations
security_operations.text: Support correlation, triage, and threat-oriented investigation across multiple environments and operational teams.

observability.title: Observability
observability.text: Improve visibility across services, infrastructure, and data flows when signals live in different systems and tools.

incident_investigation.title: Incident investigation
incident_investigation.text: Help teams investigate incidents faster by connecting related records, dependencies, and operational evidence.

compliance_visibility.title: Compliance visibility
compliance_visibility.text: Support compliance-oriented reporting and evidence review across the systems that already hold the relevant data.

what_is_saf.question: What is SAF in practical terms?
what_is_saf.answer: SAF is Search Anywhere Framework, a platform for search, analysis, correlation, observability, cybersecurity, incident response, compliance, and AI-assisted analysis across distributed enterprise data.

where_value_comes_from.question: Why do teams look at SAF instead of centralizing everything first?
where_value_comes_from.answer: A core SAF value is helping teams work across existing systems without requiring a complete migration into one central storage before they can start seeing operational value.

what_harmony_does.question: What is Harmony Technology's role?
what_harmony_does.answer: Harmony Technology is positioned as a Japan-focused partner of SAF-Systems, supporting communication, partner discussions, business development, and SAF-based solution scenarios for the Japanese market.

is_pricing_public.question: Is pricing shown as a final public offer?

descriptions: Search across multiple enterprise data environments without forcing every source into one new storage layer first.
Connect IT, security, and business data domains while keeping room for phased adoption and operational ownership.
Share documents, diagrams, dashboards, and views that help teams move from raw data to operational understanding.
Support root-cause analysis, anomaly review, dependency understanding, and deeper investigation across related datasets.
Extend workflows, integrate APIs, and support automation around SAF-based operational processes.

features.title: Platform areas for real operational use
features.description: SAF combines product capabilities that can be introduced in stages and aligned with the needs of IT, security, operations, and business teams.
descriptions: Core search, processing, automation, and service modeling capabilities that support broader solution delivery.
Capture, track, and respond to incidents with workflows that support operational coordination and investigation.
Build broader visibility across users, assets, and connected systems to improve operational context.
Support assessments, controls tracking, and reporting views that help teams understand compliance posture.
Use correlation, detection logic, integrations, and dashboards to support modern cyber operations.
Map techniques, visualize coverage, and support structured security analysis.
Monitor network devices, configurations, changes, and operational health across distributed environments.
Track server health, resource usage, and system signals that matter to operational teams.
Review account activity, changes, hygiene, and directory-related security questions.
Understand email activity, flows, and suspicious changes that deserve operational review.
Discover and visualize connectivity, topology, and relationships across network infrastructure.
Analyze user and group behavior patterns to support anomaly review and investigation.

Assist with continuous improvement, change requests, and operational follow-up after initial deployment stages.
